name: ai-video-cutter
description: Plataforma local-first de edição automática de vídeos com IA (V1: base de frontend + backend, sem IA ainda)

scripts.build:shared: npm run build --workspace=packages/shared-types && npm run build --workspace=packages/shared-utils
scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -k -n FRONTEND,BACKEND -c blue,green "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run dev:backend"
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspace=apps/backend && npm run build --workspace=apps/frontend
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace=apps/frontend && npm run lint --workspace=apps/backend
